content: The ort crate (pykeio/ort) wraps ONNX Runtime for Rust. Core API: Session::builder() configures optimization level, thread count, and execution providers (CUDA, TensorRT, CPU fallback). Session::run() takes inputs! macro-constructed tensors and returns SessionOutputs. Session requires &mut self for run() due to non-thread-safe ORT internals — use one session per thread or serialize access. Supports IoBinding for advanced I/O, async inference, profiling, and ModelCompiler for AOT optimization.
